words.example: Abolish the old stamp only after the new form is printed.
words.exampleZh: 新表格印好之後，再廢除舊印花。
words.notes: abolish 的受詞是制度、規定或稅，不是人。

words.example: Two clerks spent the morning cleaning up the tax account.
words.exampleZh: 兩名職員花了一上午整理稅務帳。
words.notes: account book 是帳冊。on account of 是由於。

words.example: The accountant must separate this account from the payroll.
words.exampleZh: 會計師必須把這個帳戶和薪資帳分開。
words.notes: accountant 是人。account 是帳戶或帳目。

words.example: Clients admire her for finding the missing receipt.
words.exampleZh: 客戶欽佩她找出了那張不見的收據。
words.notes: admire sb for 是因某事欽佩某人。

words.example: The auditor will admonish any clerk who skips a total.
words.exampleZh: 審計員會告誡漏加總額的職員。
words.notes: admonish sb against 是警告某人不要做。

words.example: She will advocate a simpler form for small shops.
words.exampleZh: 她會提倡小店使用更簡單的表格。
words.notes: advocate 後面可接名詞或動名詞。

words.example: Each office received the same allotment of tax forms.
words.exampleZh: 每個辦公室分到的稅表數量相同。

words.example: The size of the refund amazed the owner.
words.exampleZh: 退稅金額讓老闆吃驚。
words.notes: be amazed at 是對……感到吃驚。

words.example: She receives the annuity on the first Monday of each quarter.
words.exampleZh: 她每季的第一個星期一領這筆年金。
words.notes: annuity insurance 是年金保險。

words.example: The shop will appeal the assessment before Friday.
words.exampleZh: 這家店會在星期五前對核定稅額提出上訴。
words.notes: appeal to sb for 是向某人請求。appeal for 是呼籲得到某物。

words.example: The totals appear correct, but one page is missing.
words.exampleZh: 總額看起來沒錯，但少了一頁。
words.notes: appear to 是似乎。appear 後面可接形容詞。

words.example: Tired clerks are apt to transpose two digits.
words.exampleZh: 職員累了就容易把兩位數字對調。
words.notes: be apt to 是易於做某事。

words.example: The team could not ascertain who changed the total.
words.exampleZh: 小組查不出是誰改了總額。
words.notes: ascertain that，或 ascertain the cause。

words.example: The audit started with the cash book, not the invoices.
words.exampleZh: 查帳從現金簿開始，不是從發票開始。
words.notes: annual audit 是年度查帳。

words.example: The auditor asked for the December bundle again.
words.exampleZh: 審計員又要了十二月那疊單據。
words.notes: internal auditor 是內部稽核。

words.example: Shops may boycott the new stamp if the queue stays this long.
words.exampleZh: 如果排隊一直這麼久，店家可能會抵制新印花。
words.notes: boycott foreign goods 是抵制外國貨。

words.example: Nobody offered a bribe, and nobody was asked for one.
words.exampleZh: 沒有人行賄，也沒有人索賄。
words.notes: bribe sb to do 是賄賂某人去做。

words.example: The office will exceed its budget if the overtime stays.
words.exampleZh: 加班若繼續，這個單位會超出預算。
words.notes: exceed a budget 是超出預算。作動詞是編列預算。

words.example: The statistics bureau publishes the trade figures.
words.exampleZh: 統計局公布貿易數字。
words.notes: tax bureau 是稅務局。

words.example: Calculate the duty before the crate leaves the dock.
words.exampleZh: 貨箱離港前先把關稅算出來。

words.example: One wrong calculation threw off the whole return.
words.exampleZh: 一個計算錯誤讓整份申報表都歪了。
words.notes: field calculation 是現場計算。

words.example: This desk does not cater for walk-in questions after four.
words.exampleZh: 這個窗口四點後不受理臨櫃問題。
words.notes: cater for 或 cater to 是迎合、滿足。cater 也可指承辦宴席。

words.example: No one could certify that the cash count was complete.
words.exampleZh: 沒有人能證明現金清點是完整的。
words.notes: certify that，或 be certified as。

words.example: Clearing of these cheques takes one more business day.
words.exampleZh: 這些支票的清算還要一個營業日。

words.example: The crates cannot leave until customs signs the form.
words.exampleZh: 海關在表格上簽核之前，貨箱不能離港。
words.notes: customs declaration 是報關單。指習俗時也是這個複數形式。

words.example: Declare the cash before you reach the inspection desk.
words.exampleZh: 到檢查臺之前先把現金申報。
words.notes: declare 後面可接 that 子句，或 declare sth to sb。

words.example: The office will deduct the levy before the salary is paid.
words.exampleZh: 發薪前，單位會先把這筆稅扣掉。
words.notes: be deducted from 是從……扣除。

words.example: The donation is deductible only with the receipt attached.
words.exampleZh: 捐款要附上收據才可扣除。
words.notes: tax deductible 是可扣稅的。fully deductible 是可全額扣除。

words.example: A hiring freeze will not close the budget deficit.
words.exampleZh: 凍結用人補不上預算赤字。
words.notes: make up the deficit 是彌補赤字。

words.example: The report will denounce any rebate that skipped the books.
words.exampleZh: 報告會譴責任何沒入帳的退稅。
words.notes: denounce sb as 是把某人痛斥為。

words.example: These samples are dutiable even though they were free.
words.exampleZh: 這些樣品雖然免費，仍然要課稅。

words.example: The duty on this crate is higher than the goods inside.
words.exampleZh: 這箱貨的關稅比裡面的貨還高。
words.notes: duties 常指各項關稅或職責。

words.example: The firm tried to evade the duty by mislabeling the crates.
words.exampleZh: 這家公司用標錯貨箱的方式逃避關稅。
words.notes: evade 後面可接名詞或動名詞。

words.example: Every crate was taxed except the labeled samples.
words.exampleZh: 除了貼好標籤的樣品，每一箱都課了稅。
words.notes: except that 後面接子句。except what 是除了……的東西。

words.example: The excise on bottled drinks rose in May.
words.exampleZh: 瓶裝飲料的消費稅五月調高了。
words.notes: excise 作動詞也可指切除。excise office 是消費稅機關。

words.example: The exciseman spotted the missing stamp at a glance.
words.exampleZh: 稅務員一眼就看出少了印花。

words.example: Small shops are exempt from this filing if turnover stays low.
words.exampleZh: 營業額維持很低的小店，免於申報這一項。
words.notes: exempt sb from 是免除某人某義務。be exempt from 是不必承擔。

words.example: They applied for an exemption and attached the receipt.
words.exampleZh: 他們申請免除，並附上收據。
words.notes: exemption clause 是免責條款。

words.example: These parts are for export, so the form is different.
words.exampleZh: 這些零件要出口，表格不一樣。
words.notes: export from 是從某地出口。export to 是出口到某地。

words.example: A second office car would be an extravagance this year.
words.exampleZh: 今年再買一輛公務車就是奢侈。
words.notes: excessive extravagance 是過度奢侈。

words.example: Without new finance, the refund desk will close early.
words.exampleZh: 沒有新的經費，退稅窗口會提早關閉。
words.notes: finance department 是財務部門。作動詞是提供資金。

words.example: The financial report shows the levy was underpaid.
words.exampleZh: 財務報告顯示這項稅少繳了。
words.notes: financial crisis 是金融危機。

words.example: Late filing brings a forfeit on top of the tax itself.
words.exampleZh: 逾期申報除了稅本身還有罰金。
words.notes: forfeit 作動詞是喪失資格或沒收。

words.example: The gauger checked the cask before the duty was set.
words.exampleZh: 稅額核定前，計量員先檢查了木桶。
words.notes: 負責量測應稅貨物的人。

words.example: Customs held the crates in the harbor until the receipt arrived.
words.exampleZh: 收據送到之前，海關把貨箱留在港口。
words.notes: 美式拼法 harbor。也可作動詞，表示窩藏或心懷。

words.example: The clerk was ignorant of the new rate.
words.exampleZh: 這名職員不知道新稅率。
words.notes: be ignorant of 是不知道。

words.example: The import duty doubled on this category in March.
words.exampleZh: 這一類貨物的進口稅三月調高了一倍。
words.notes: import licence 是進口許可。

words.example: They will impose a higher duty on the luxury crates.
words.exampleZh: 他們會對豪華貨箱課更高的稅。
words.notes: impose A on B 是把 A 加在 B 上。

words.example: Shops heard about the imposition only after the invoices arrived.
words.exampleZh: 發票來了，店家才聽說這項徵收。
words.notes: 徵收這件事，或把負擔加在別人身上。

words.example: The impost on this lot has not been set.
words.exampleZh: 這一批的稅還沒核定。
words.notes: impost on 是對……徵的稅。

words.example: His reported income does not cover the declared spending.
words.exampleZh: 他申報的收入涵蓋不了申報的支出。
words.notes: bring in income 是帶來收入。

words.example: The senior rate gets an annual increment.
words.exampleZh: 資深級距每年有一次加薪。
words.notes: rate of increment 是增加率。

words.example: A penalty waiver is an irresistible reason to file early.
words.exampleZh: 罰鍰可以免除，這是提早申報的強力理由。
words.notes: 強烈到讓人難以拒絕。

words.example: A junior clerk may prepare the form but may not sign it.
words.exampleZh: 資淺職員可以準備表格，但不能簽名。
words.notes: junior to 是比……資淺或年齡小。

words.example: A cash payment is lawful only with a numbered receipt.
words.exampleZh: 現金付款要有編號收據才合法。

words.example: The city will levy the new charge from July.
words.exampleZh: 市府將從七月起徵收這項新費用。
words.notes: levy a tax on 是對某對象課稅。

words.example: The maker of the note is liable if the bank refuses it.
words.exampleZh: 銀行拒付時，出票人要負責。
words.notes: maker 在別的上下文也可指製造者。

words.example: A mathematical check caught the transposed total.
words.exampleZh: 一道精確的驗算抓到了對調的總額。
words.notes: 和數學有關，或指用數字做的驗算。

words.example: You have no option but to attach the receipt.
words.exampleZh: 你只能附上收據，沒有別的選擇。
words.notes: at sb's option 是由某人選擇。

words.example: The outlay for new software exceeded the filing budget.
words.exampleZh: 新軟體的支出超過了申報預算。
words.notes: capital outlay 是資本支出。

words.example: Do not overdraw the tax account to meet Friday's payment.
words.exampleZh: 不要透支稅務帳戶來付星期五的款。
words.notes: 過去式 overdrew，過去分詞 overdrawn。字頭本身是 overdraw。

words.example: Each paycheck needs a signature before it leaves the office.
words.exampleZh: 每張薪資支票離開辦公室前都要簽名。
words.notes: 發薪用的支票，也可泛指一次薪資。

words.example: The office will penalize a late file even if the tax was paid.
words.exampleZh: 即使稅已繳，逾期申報仍會受罰。
words.notes: penalize sb for 是因某事處罰某人。

words.example: There is a penalty if the form arrives after the date.
words.exampleZh: 表格若過了日期才到，就有罰款。
words.notes: light penalty 是輕罰。

words.example: One wrong posting sent the payment to last year's book.
words.exampleZh: 一筆過帳錯誤把這筆款記到了去年的帳。
words.notes: double posting 是重複過帳。

words.example: The principal must be listed apart from the interest.
words.exampleZh: 本金必須和利息分開列。
words.notes: principle 是原則，拼法不同。

words.example: The rule will punish a false total, not an honest mistake that is corrected.
words.exampleZh: 這項規定罰的是假總額，不是已更正的誠實錯誤。
words.notes: punish 多用於被動：be punished。

words.example: The salary range for this post is printed on the notice.
words.exampleZh: 這個職位的薪資範圍印在公告上。
words.notes: within range 是在範圍內。作動詞是（在某範圍內）變化。

words.example: The new rule will regulate how cash refunds are paid.
words.exampleZh: 新規定會管制現金退稅怎麼付。
words.notes: regulate 後面可接名詞或疑問詞子句。

words.example: The revelation of a second set of books stopped the refund.
words.exampleZh: 第二套帳被揭發後，退稅就停了。
words.notes: 原本沒公開的事被揭露出來。

words.example: Trade revenue fell, but the levy still rose.
words.exampleZh: 貿易收入下降了，這項稅收仍然增加。
words.notes: revenue 多作不可數名詞。revenue tax 是稅收。

words.example: A senior clerk has to sign any refund above this line.
words.exampleZh: 超過這條線的退稅必須由資深職員簽名。
words.notes: senior to 是比……資深。

words.example: Her shrewdness saved the shop from a needless penalty.
words.exampleZh: 她的精明讓店裡免了一筆不必要的罰款。

words.example: Office spending on postage is higher than the budget line.
words.exampleZh: 辦公室的郵資支出高於預算那一列。
words.notes: spending 是不可數名詞。

words.example: The statistics show most late files come from one form.
words.exampleZh: 統計資料顯示，大多數逾期件來自同一種表格。
words.notes: 作「統計資料」時形似複數，常當複數用。

words.example: A surplus in March covered the shortfall in April.
words.exampleZh: 三月的盈餘補上了四月的短缺。
words.notes: trade surplus 是貿易順差。

words.example: The tariff on these parts rose without a public notice.
words.exampleZh: 這些零件的關稅漲了，事先沒有公告。
words.notes: tariff wall 是關稅壁壘。

words.example: The tax on this invoice is already included in the total.
words.exampleZh: 這張發票的稅已經含在總額裡。
words.notes: tax 作名詞可數或不可數都可以。

words.example: Double taxation would hit the same profit twice.
words.exampleZh: 雙重課稅會讓同一筆利潤被課兩次。
words.notes: taxation office 是稅務機關。

words.example: The listed items are tax-exempt only with the stamp.
words.exampleZh: 清單上的項目要有印花才免稅。
words.notes: tax-exempt 中間有連字號。

words.example: The allowance is tax-free, and the bonus is not.
words.exampleZh: 這筆津貼免稅，獎金則不免。
words.notes: duty-free 是免關稅的。untaxed 是未課稅的。

words.example: Every taxpayer on this list must file by Friday.
words.exampleZh: 這份名單上的每位納稅人必須在星期五前申報。
words.notes: taxpayer receipt 是納稅人收據。

words.example: Ask the teller to stamp the receipt before you leave.
words.exampleZh: 離開前請出納員在收據上蓋章。

words.example: A missing signature will violate the filing rule.
words.exampleZh: 少了簽名就違反申報規定。
words.notes: violate 後面接法律、規定或協議。
